phase_name: CLOSURE ADDENDUM -- THREE MISSING END-TO-END SEMANTIC TRACES
purpose: Adds 3 new cross-company traces to reach the originally required >=10 end-to-end trace closure standard

trace_selection.trace_8_tanla: MP-0152 / CAO-0011 -- ValueFirst acquisition (in_progress lifecycle + later financial movement -> causal discipline test)
trace_selection.trace_9_datapatterns: CAO-0003 -- Capacity Expansion (execution UNABLE_TO_VERIFY + NO_OUTCOME_EVIDENCE preservation test)

traces.claim: ValueFirst acquisition (strategic acquisition of ValueFirst from Twilio)

source_evidence.verbatim: In three quarters since the acquisition, I am happy that we integrated their India business very quickly and have been able to drive double-digit EBITDA (from mid-single digits pre-acquisition) resulting in an ROI of 20%+ on the acquisition payout based on exit run rate.
source_evidence.causal_meaning: Management claims ROI of 20%+ based on exit run rate (CEO letter, direct attribution)
source_evidence.unknown_state: ROI claim is management-stated; independent financial verification separate

management_progression.theme: Strategic acquisition of ValueFirst referenced as a lead contributor
management_progression.notes: in_progress -- NOT inflated to completed or operational

cao.causal_discipline: PASS -- CAO correctly maintains NO_OUTCOME_EVIDENCE; does not independently attribute ROI claim

company_model.mention: acquiring complementary businesses (ValueFirst acquisition with >20% ROI on payout...)
company_model.notes: Sourced from management statement -- quoting, not asserting independent causality

pcim.sample: M&A activity is a clear secondary growth lever (ValueFirst acquisition with >20% ROI and dedicated acquisition capital)
pcim.notes: Carries verbatim management claim; does not invent independent ROI proof

investor_panel.routing: NOT_MATERIAL -- panel synthesizes at thesis level, not individual acquisition

ask.routing: NOT_MATERIAL -- capital allocation answer does not name specific acquisitions individually

traces.causal_discipline_notes: ROI claim is sourced verbatim from Tanla CEO FY24 letter (page 39). CAO independently maintains NO_OUTCOME_EVIDENCE and UNABLE_TO_ATTRIBUTE. No layer invents causal attribution beyond the management statement. CAUSAL_DISCIPLINE = PASS.

traces.claim: Capacity Expansion (CAO-0003) -- capital deployed for manufacturing/facility expansion

source_evidence.causal_meaning: Expansion capital deployed; no financial outcome confirmed

management_progression.notes: MP correctly shows partially_delivered or announced -- NOT completed or operational

pcim.routing: NOT_MATERIAL at phrase level; capacity handled under economic engines

investor_panel.buffett_framing: allocations lack attributable financial outcomes; facility additions not yet proven to produce durable margin or cash returns
investor_panel.causal_discipline: PASS -- Panel explicitly states lack of attribution, not confirmation

ask.framing: capacity expansion in unverified outcomes bucket: allocations with unverified outcomes: research and development, capacity expansion, equity issuance

traces.causal_discipline_notes: Panel says 'most allocations lack attributable financial outcomes' and 'facility additions not yet proven'. ASK lists capacity expansion in unverified bucket. NO_OUTCOME_EVIDENCE preserved through all layers. CAUSAL_DISCIPLINE = PASS.

traces.claim: Debt repayment (CAO-0001) -- deterministic transaction + sparse-evidence preservation

source_evidence.unknown_state: Deterministic -- no uncertainty about consequence of debt repayment

cao.notes: DIRECTLY_ATTRIBUTABLE is correct: debt_repayment is a DETERMINISTIC_TRANSACTION exception per attribution taxonomy

management_progression.routing: NOT_MATERIAL -- debt repayment is a financial transaction, not a management commitment item

ask.framing: debt repayment (FY21) -- deployed / execution complete; Financial return attributable: debt repayment: direct cash-flow effect

sparse_evidence_preservation.notes: 9/11 Ujjivan allocations correctly remain NO_OUTCOME_EVIDENCE with UNABLE_TO_VERIFY execution -- sparse evidence NOT converted to success/failure/completed

traces.unknown_preservation_notes: 9/11 Ujjivan allocations are NO_OUTCOME_EVIDENCE with UNABLE_TO_VERIFY. DIRECTLY_ATTRIBUTABLE restricted to debt_repayment (deterministic transaction). Sparse evidence NOT inflated. UNKNOWN_PRESERVATION = PASS.
